name: Feel the aura
description: A glowing aura surrounds you while you point at your head.
origin: The “+1000 aura” meme: a moment of pure, unbothered confidence.
whatHappens: A glowing purple aura hugs your outline, with rising wisps and “+1000 AURA”.
how: Point both index fingers at your head and hold for half a second.
tips: Only index fingers out; open hands don’t count.
